description: Example capsule configuration for Supabase backend development

usage.description: Use this config for capsules that need Supabase database integration
setup_steps: 1. Get Supabase project reference from dashboard (Settings → General → Project Reference)
2. Generate access token (Account Settings → Access Tokens)
7. Restart Claude Code or run session reload
example_workflow: Use supabase-schema-architect agent to design schema
Agent uses MCP to execute migration

notes: Supabase is an optional MCP in the 'default' profile - must be explicitly included
Credentials are loaded from capsule .env file at runtime
Backend Dev agent handles all Supabase database work
Agent has write access to apply migrations and execute schema changes
Use --read-only flag in MCP args to prevent accidental writes during exploration
